page.title: Traditional AI comparison
page.description: Ways users contrast Lexi with predictive LLMs.

entries.input: How is Lexi different from an LLM?
entries.response: Lexi does not use neural next-token prediction. This prototype scores recorded examples and combines selected material through explicit linguistic rules.

slots.subject: Lexi
slots.object: deterministic rules instead of next-token prediction

entries.response: Traditional LLMs generate from learned probability distributions; Lexi’s prototype follows deterministic searches, context scores, and sentence structures.
